name: Merissa Martinez
background: Merissa Martinez of Albany County won the 2026 Republican primary for county treasurer and lost the November 2026 general election. The Laramie Reporter reported the results as 4,656 votes (37%) to Tracy Fletcher's 8,066 (63%). No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
